description: Update one of your ordinary one-shot bounties; only the fields you pass change. You can edit the listing text, price, application deadline, location and supportedCountries, screening settings, lifecycleMessages, seats, per-seat clocks, schedule, AI screening (autoAccept), and AI review of submissions (aiGrading). Status 'paused' stops new applications and outreach, 'open' resumes, and 'closed' closes an unassigned bounty and returns its unused funding; 'completed' and 'paid' are system-managed and cannot be set. Use cancel_bounty to cancel. An edit cannot grow an escrow-funded pool above $10,000. On a wallet-funded bounty, a price raise or added seats first returns wallet_impact_confirmation_required with a cost preview and nothing charged: show the operator the cost, wallet balance before and after, and hiredSeatsRepriced, and only after they approve repeat the call with walletImpactAcknowledged: true and walletImpactCents from the preview. A raise after hiring reprices every hired worker. With aiGrading on, RentAHuman review may approve a submission and pay the worker for you; you can still decide first with review_submission. Clock changes (completionWindowHours, startWindowMinutes, responseWindowHours, autoExpireGhosts) apply only to seats confirmed after the edit; moving scheduledStartAt later pushes back confirmed workers' deadlines and never brings one forward. The 2-hour seat-confirmation window is fixed. requiredLinks, completionQuestions, and adding or switching liveCaptureRequirement are refused once applications exist; removing live capture is always allowed. AI-managed bounties allow only task-content and deadline edits; QA and taste runs and ongoing-bounty settings are not editable here.

aiChatAssistant.description: Reserved for the AI chat assistant, which is not available yet. Passing true is refused with 400 and the setting stays off.

aiGrading.description: Turn AI review on or off. When on, our AI reviews each new evidence submission against what was agreed at acceptance. Its verdict is not shown to you, and RentAHuman review may approve the submission and pay the worker on your behalf; until then you can still approve, request changes or reject with review_submission. Default false. AI review needs submissions you review.

applicationDetails.description: Update application detail items. Blank rows are ignored. Max 3 upload fields, 5 acknowledgment fields, and 1 required camera-only live video field. Only allowed when applicationCount is 0.

allowedFileTypes.description: For file_upload fields. Supports image, docx, pdf, txt, video, and audio.
allowedFileTypes.title: maxItems(6)

description.description: Short helper text shown under the field.
description.title: maxLength(240)

id.description: Stable field ID. If omitted, the API derives one from the label.
id.title: maxLength(64)

label.description: Applicant-facing prompt text. Blank rows are ignored. Questions and uploads allow 120 characters, acknowledgments allow 200, and a live-video reading script allows 500.
label.title: maxLength(500)

maxFiles.description: For file_upload fields. Application uploads are normalized to one file per upload field.
maxFiles.title: lessThanOrEqualTo(3)

maxLength.description: Text field character limit. Default 200, max 500.
maxLength.title: lessThanOrEqualTo(500)

required.description: Whether a question, upload, or acknowledgment blocks application submission. live_video is always required.

type.description: Applicant detail item type: text, checkbox (acknowledgment), file_upload, or live_video (camera-only recording).

applicationDetails.title: maxItems(10)

anyOf.description: a number less than or equal to 2000
anyOf.title: lessThanOrEqualTo(2000)

attendanceRadiusMeters.description: In-person attendance: radius in meters around the job site (the bounty’s geocoded location) within which a hired worker counts as on site while attendance tracking is on. 50–2000, default 150. Only used when location.isRemoteAllowed is false. Pass null to restore the default.

autoAccept.description: Turn AI screening on or off. When on, your blocklist always applies, qualified applicants are accepted, and clear mismatches are rejected; applications the review cannot decide stay pending for your manual review. Applications received while off stay pending; toggling on affects future applications only. Turning it off pauses AI screening at once: an automatic acceptance still in progress is refused and the applicant stays pending for you. Ignored on aiManaged bounties. AI screening needs an application step.

anyOf.description: a number less than or equal to 5
anyOf.title: lessThanOrEqualTo(5)

autoAcceptMinMicScore.description: Change the minimum overall mic score (1-5) for automatic review on micCheckRequired bounties — applications scoring below your configured cutoff are auto-rejected, at/above proceed toward acceptance — or pass null to reset to the platform default (3.0, below which applications only stay pending). Affects future applications only.

autoExpireGhosts.description: When true (with responseWindowHours set), ghosting workers’ seats are auto-released at the deadline and the listing reopens.

bountyId.description: The unique ID of the bounty to update

checkIns.description: Live selfie check-ins for in-person shifts: { enabled, intervalMinutes (whole minutes, 5-240) }. While a hired worker is on the job they take a camera-only, location-stamped selfie in the job chat every intervalMinutes from when they tap Start; you see each photo, its server time, distance to the job site and any flags, plus missed check-ins (never raw coordinates). enabled true requires an in-person bounty (location.isRemoteAllowed false). Omit it for the default: on every 15 minutes for sign-holding campaigns, off otherwise. Changing it affects check-ins from now on; past check-ins are kept. To make an on-site bounty with check-ins enabled remote, send checkIns with enabled false in the same update.

completionQuestions.description: Mandatory questions the accepted WORKER answers when submitting evidence (for example "Which counter did you use?"). Max 10, prompts up to 300 characters, required defaults to true. Distinct from applicationDetails, which screens applicants before acceptance. Visible to workers before they apply. Locked once applications are received (409): accepted work snapshots the questions.

id.description: Stable question ID. If omitted, the API derives one from the prompt.
id.title: maxLength(64)

prompt.description: Worker-facing question answered when submitting evidence. Blank rows are ignored. Max 300 characters.
prompt.title: maxLength(300)

required.description: Whether the worker must answer before their submission is accepted. Default true.

completionQuestions.title: maxItems(10)

anyOf.description: a number less than or equal to 720
anyOf.title: lessThanOrEqualTo(720)

completionWindowHours.description: Auto-reassign completion deadline as any whole number of hours from 1 to 720 (30 days), or null to disable. Only affects seats confirmed after the edit — live per-worker deadlines are not re-timed, except that moving scheduledStartAt later pushes them back.

deadline.description: New application cutoff (ISO 8601), based on the user’s schedule. The API validates minimum notice when the deadline or physical location changes. This does not retime accepted workers.

documentSubmission.description: Document-upload submission settings. Required when setting submissionMode to document_upload.

acceptText.description: a string at most 50 character(s) long
acceptText.title: maxLength(50)

confirmationMessage.description: a string at most 1000 character(s) long
confirmationMessage.title: maxLength(1000)

consentText.description: a string at most 1000 character(s) long
consentText.title: maxLength(1000)

maxDocuments.description: a number less than or equal to 10
maxDocuments.title: lessThanOrEqualTo(10)

estimatedHours.description: New estimated duration in hours (min 5 minutes = 0.083). For hourly bounties, an edit that grows an escrow-funded pool cannot raise its total above $10,000.
estimatedHours.title: greaterThanOrEqualTo(0.08333333333333333)

evidenceTypes.description: Updated evidence types. At least one required when present.
evidenceTypes.title: minItems(1)

excludedParticipantSourceBountyIds.description: Replace the exclude-previous-participants list: ids of your own earlier regular bounties (max 1000), never this bounty itself. An empty array clears it. Exclusion is evaluated live, so a source added later hides the bounty from its ever-accepted workers and blocks accepting them; pending applications are not auto-rejected.
excludedParticipantSourceBountyIds.title: maxItems(1000)

identityRequired.description: Require applicants to pass an identity check (government ID) before applying. Verified once per account and reused across bounties.

keepApplicantsOnFill.description: When true, pending applicants are kept (not auto-rejected) even after every seat escrow settles, so you can draw from the same pool after reopening or adding seats. By default applicants are already kept while seats are merely filled and are only auto-rejected at settlement. Default false.

language.description: Spoken language to assess. Only 'en' (English) is supported; other values are rejected.

minimumCefr.description: Minimum CEFR speaking band the applicant must reach: A2, B1, B2, C1, or C2. Compared against the most likely band from a scored check.

languageProficiencyRequirement.description: Require applicants to pass an English speaking-proficiency check before applying. The applicant records about 45 seconds of spontaneous speech in the app; it is transcribed and scored automatically, and only a scored result at or above minimumCefr qualifies. Recordings that cannot be scored (too little speech, low confidence) ask the applicant to retry. A worker's scored level is saved on their profile as a lasting credential, reused across every bounty without retesting (only a newer scored check replaces it), and re-checked against the bounty's current threshold at acceptance; a stored level below your threshold still requires a new recording. Shape: { language: 'en', minimumCefr: 'A2' | 'B1' | 'B2' | 'C1' | 'C2' }. Omit for no requirement. Separate from micCheckRequired. Pass null to remove the requirement. Changing the threshold applies to new applications and to every pending applicant at acceptance time.

lifecycleMessages.description: Auto-sent to the doer in the bounty conversation on lifecycle transitions. Supports {{name}}, {{bountyTitle}}, {{deadline}}, {{reason}} interpolation. Accepted/submission templates are only ever delivered to accepted applicants.

onAccepted.description: a string at most 2000 character(s) long
onAccepted.title: maxLength(2000)

onRejected.description: a string at most 2000 character(s) long
onRejected.title: maxLength(2000)

onSubmissionApproved.description: a string at most 2000 character(s) long
onSubmissionApproved.title: maxLength(2000)

onSubmissionReceived.description: a string at most 2000 character(s) long
onSubmissionReceived.title: maxLength(2000)

onSubmissionRejected.description: a string at most 2000 character(s) long
onSubmissionRejected.title: maxLength(2000)

linkedinVerifiedRequired.description: Require applicants to have a verified LinkedIn: they must sign in with LinkedIn (OAuth) on their Rent A Human account before applying. A pasted LinkedIn URL does not count. Applicants without one get 403 with code "linkedin_verification_required". Use requiredLinks instead when you only need a LinkedIn URL. Default false. Can be switched on or off while the bounty is live, including after applications arrive; it applies to new applications only and never removes existing applicants.

liveCaptureRequirement.description: Require new photo or video evidence captured with the device camera, or null to remove the requirement. Removing it is allowed at any time; adding or switching it is only allowed before applications are received. If both photo and video evidence are required, both must be captured live. Live video is limited to 60 seconds and 250 MiB.

location.description: Worker location target. Set country to an ISO country code without city or state to target every eligible worker in that country, including when remote work is allowed. Include city (and optionally state/country) for city-level targeting. Countries where RentAHuman is not available are rejected.

city.description: a string at most 100 character(s) long
city.title: maxLength(100)

country.description: a string at most 100 character(s) long
country.title: maxLength(100)

state.description: a string at most 100 character(s) long
state.title: maxLength(100)

micCheckRequired.description: Require applicants to pass an on-device microphone quality check before applying (max 2 attempts; result visible on each application).

photoSubmission.description: Photo-upload submission settings. Required when setting submissionMode to photo_upload.

acceptText.description: a string at most 50 character(s) long
acceptText.title: maxLength(50)

confirmationMessage.description: a string at most 1000 character(s) long
confirmationMessage.title: maxLength(1000)

consentText.description: a string at most 1000 character(s) long
consentText.title: maxLength(1000)

maxImages.description: a number less than or equal to 4
maxImages.title: lessThanOrEqualTo(4)

minimumResolutionPx.description: a number less than or equal to 10000
minimumResolutionPx.title: lessThanOrEqualTo(10000)

price.description: New per-worker price (minimum $1). In-person bounties inside a configured minimum-pay area must meet that area's hourly minimum; fixed prices are divided by estimatedHours for this check. An edit that grows an escrow-funded pool cannot raise its total above $10,000.
price.title: lessThanOrEqualTo(1000000)

reactivate.description: Reactivate a bounty that was hidden after a period of inactivity.

requiredLinks.description: Update required links. Only allowed when applicationCount is 0.

label.description: a string at most 100 character(s) long
label.title: maxLength(100)

requiredLinks.title: maxItems(10)

anyOf.description: a number less than or equal to 720
anyOf.title: lessThanOrEqualTo(720)

responseWindowHours.description: Hours an accepted worker has to show activity before their seat is treated as ghosted (1-720), or null to remove the ghost policy. Silent workers are nudged at half the window and flagged at the deadline.

scheduleTimes.description: Local start/end hours and minutes for an existing task schedule. Availability, time increments, and timing restrictions depend on the task type; currently supported for managed sign campaigns. Keeps dates, timezone, and paid duration unchanged.

scheduledStartAt.description: When the work starts, for tasks booked for a specific time (a shift, an appointment, an event). ISO 8601 date-time with a UTC offset, in the future, e.g. 2026-10-03T07:30:00-07:00. With startWindowMinutes, the start deadline is this time plus the window rather than confirmation plus the window; completionWindowHours likewise counts from this time, so a worker who confirms early keeps the spot until then. Recommended for in-person shifts: set it with scheduledStartTimeZone (and estimatedHours as the shift length) so workers already booked at that time are not shown or alerted about the bounty and cannot double-book. Omit for tasks that start as soon as the worker confirms. The API never reads a schedule from the description. Pass null to clear. Moving it later also pushes back the start and submission deadlines of workers already confirmed; it never brings a live deadline forward.

scheduledStartTimeZone.description: IANA time zone of the task location (e.g. America/Los_Angeles), used to show workers the scheduled start in local time. Needs scheduledStartAt. Set it on in-person shifts: double-booking protection only uses a scheduled start that has its time zone. Pass null to clear.

spotsAvailable.description: Change the number of seats (humans needed, 1-2000). Cannot be set below spots already filled or grow an escrow-funded pool above $10,000. On a wallet-funded bounty the pool is resized in place: extra seats are debited from the poster wallet, freed seats are refunded to it.
spotsAvailable.title: lessThanOrEqualTo(2000)

anyOf.description: a number less than or equal to 1440
anyOf.title: lessThanOrEqualTo(1440)

startWindowMinutes.description: Start commitment: minutes after the worker confirms their seat (or after acceptance when skipAcceptanceConfirmation is true) by which they must press Start or upload evidence, otherwise the seat is eligible for release. When scheduledStartAt is set, the window runs from the scheduled start instead, so a worker who confirms early keeps the spot until then. Whole number of minutes from 5 to 1440 (24 hours). Distinct from the fixed 2-hour seat-confirmation window and from completionWindowHours, the submission deadline. Pass null to disable. Only affects seats armed after the edit; live start clocks are never re-timed.

status.description: New owner-managed status. Owners can pause/unpause a bounty or close it before accepting a worker. 'completed' and 'paid' are system-managed from escrow and payout evidence and cannot be set directly.

submissionMode.description: How users submit to this bounty. 'application' shows the standard application form; 'photo_upload' shows consent and image upload; 'video_upload' shows consent and video upload; 'document_upload' shows consent and document upload.

supportedCountries.description: Replace the eligible-country list with the full new list of ISO country codes (country names are also recognized), e.g. ["US", "CA", "GB", "NZ", "AU"]. Omitting it leaves an explicit multi-country list in place, so a location-only edit never drops it; legacy bounties that only mirror a country-only location keep deriving that single country from location. On-site bounties (isRemoteAllowed false) with a location country accept only that one country. An empty array is stored as an explicit empty list; it never lifts a country-only or on-site country restriction (remove location.country first), while a remote city location with a country stays unrestricted as before. When location.country is set it must appear in the list. Countries where RentAHuman is not available and unrecognized values are rejected.

items.description: a string at most 100 character(s) long
items.title: maxLength(100)

supportedCountries.title: maxItems(250)

videoSubmission.description: Video-upload submission settings. Required when setting submissionMode to video_upload.

acceptText.description: a string at most 50 character(s) long
acceptText.title: maxLength(50)

confirmationMessage.description: a string at most 1000 character(s) long
confirmationMessage.title: maxLength(1000)

consentText.description: a string at most 1000 character(s) long
consentText.title: maxLength(1000)

maxVideos.description: a number less than or equal to 4
maxVideos.title: lessThanOrEqualTo(4)

walletImpactAcknowledged.description: Acknowledges the wallet impact of a wallet-funded bounty edit. Any edit that debits the poster wallet (adding seats via spotsAvailable, or raising the price) is first refused with error_code wallet_impact_confirmation_required and the exact amount; retry the same request with this set to true to apply the charge. A price raise after workers are hired also needs walletImpactCents.

walletImpactCents.description: The cents value from the wallet_impact_confirmation_required response you are confirming. Required with walletImpactAcknowledged for a price raise after workers are hired; if the cost has changed since that response, the request is refused again with the new amount and nothing is charged.
